maria: Heads-up — a customer hit a crash during the sample-app fncall flow when using a union schema that allows either an object or an array. Repro below.
maria: Repro steps: 1) call /generate with function call enabled, 2) model returns object (ok) sometimes, but after an auth retry it returns `[ {...} ]` and the SDK helper tries to validate as object -> crash.
kevin: Ugh. Is this the Node or Python sample app?
maria: Node samplekit v0.9.3 (freshly cloned). They flip between object/array only after the refresh token flow (401 -> refresh -> replay).
lisa: I can repro on py too but only when we hit the retry path. The schema we ship for the helper is `oneOf: [object, array]` and our coercion logic picks the first match. If the helper gets `[{...}]` but expects `object` first it errors on extra bracket.
kevin: That sounds like our SDK helper does eager coercion instead of trying all possibilities. Also saw double JSON-encoding in logs: `payload: "[{\"foo\":...}]"` during the retry replay.
sam: Possible root causes: 1) auth retry wraps the body as a string while re-sending, 2) helper sanitizer runs before parsing on replay. We should check the replay path in auth middleware.
ci-bot: deploy status: no failing CI for devex/samplekit on main. (just FYI)
maria: Minimal failing snippet pasted:

```
// node repro
const res = await sdk.generate({json_mode: true, function_call: {name: 'out'}})
// on first try res.json -> { foo: 'bar' }
// after 401+refresh res.json -> '[{"foo":"bar"}]' // string-encoded array
```

kevin: Workaround for now: set `json_mode: 'strict'` off, or update sample to unwrap string-encoded JSON before validation: `if (typeof v === 'string') v = JSON.parse(v)` — but that's gross.
lisa: Filing an issue and quick PR suggestion: make the replay path reuse the original parsed body (don't stringify), and change schema-checker to attempt parse/coerce across union alternatives rather than pick-first.
maria: Filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samplekit/issues/412 — summary + logs attached.
sam: I'll take the auth middleware fix (ensure the retried request body stays a native object).
kevin: I'll add a small defensive change to the schema validator to try all union branches before failing and include a small test case.
lisa: Can we also add an e2e sample test that simulates 401+refresh to avoid regressions?
maria: Yes please. Also cc @eng-ml if this impacts model-side fncall formatting.
kevin: noted. ETA for PRs: auth fix by EOD, validator by tomorrow. :thumbsup:
maria: Thanks team — keeping customer updated.
